_comment: Library data release shown on /cite, in CITATION.bib and in every archive. `authors` credits the library itself (the Zenodo record), which is not the same as the paper's author list in citation.bib; in double-blind review mode they are shown as 'Anonymous'. Release 1.1 is a separate Zenodo record created anonymously for the ISMVL 2027 review (release 1.0 is 10.5281/zenodo.22895517, with author names). Fill `doi` with the DOI Zenodo reserves for the release; leave it empty until then.
